current_registered_editor_fields.approved_localization_reason: Name alongside the middle and last names refers to the first name.
Name makes the selected field explicit.
Last Name is the usual American English label for the family name.
Company matches the field label and keeps it distinct from a personal name.
The command opens the birthday calendar when the field is selected.
The Birth row already identifies the date. Use standard American numeric month/day order without spaces or a redundant Born suffix.
The Month heading identifies the number. Preserve the original calendar line feed and replace the redundant M with its blank cell.
The editor header already says Edit Birthday. Month now identifies the arrow-controlled number above the day grid.

other_consumers_still_open.context: Four alternative introductory biographies. The DS chooser displays the registered four ARM9 texts.
other_consumers_still_open.source_meaning: A Portuguese boy drawn to sailing goes to sea at a friend’s urging. The route is recommended to new players.
other_consumers_still_open.localization_note: Use the corresponding approved chooser biography and its established names.
other_consumers_still_open.Japanese:
船乗りに漠然と憧れる
ポルトガルの少年。
友人にそそのかされて
海に出ることになる。
初めてプレイする方に
おすすめ。

other_consumers_still_open.english: A Portuguese boy dreams of the sea. A friend talks him into setting sail. Great for first-time players.
